entities.summary: Ivan Ivanovich Okhlobystin is a Russian actor, director, screenwriter, and former Orthodox priest. He was not defrocked by the Russian Orthodox Church, but was banned from priesthood for his roles in movies deemed "unworthy of the priestly dignity". He is the creative director of the company Baon.
